verdict.rationale: Bruno is an API client, not an AI gateway. Its only relevant capability is governance of its own built-in Bruno AI: on Ultimate, License Administrators control which providers and models are allowed and how requests are protected. AI traffic otherwise goes BYOK directly to the provider, and Bruno connects to company gateways or proxies only as a client, so it does not proxy LLM traffic itself. missing for 10: proxying of arbitrary LLM/MCP traffic through the platform, token limits, documented prompt guards, provider routing/failover, MCP traffic governance, independent corroboration.
